quote.text: The part of life we really live is small”. All the rest of existence is not life, but merely time.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Recognize that the true moments of life are the intimate, everyday interactions with your children; cherish these fleeting experiences rather than simply marking the passage of time.
    • In nurturing your children, focus on quality over quantity—invest your energy in creating meaningful memories that shape their character and your bond.
  • Leadership:
    • Understand that effective leadership is less about occupying endless hours and more about making every moment count by inspiring and guiding those around you.
    • Concentrate on leading with intention; let your actions during those meaningful moments drive lasting change rather than getting lost in the routine of passing time.
  • Product Management:
    • In product management, focus on the moments of genuine innovation and user engagement—these are the parts of your work that truly bring value, rather than merely following schedules.
    • Prioritize actions that enhance the product’s real impact on users' lives by being mindful of when and how you invest your time, ensuring that every decision makes a tangible difference.
